title: Moon Knight
summary: Steven Grant discovers he's been granted the powers of an Egyptian moon god. But he soon finds out that these newfound powers can be both a blessing and a curse to his troubled life. (source: IMDb)

reception.director: Mohamed Diab, Justin Benson, Aaron Moorhead
reception.actors: Oscar Isaac, Ethan Hawke, May Calamawy, F. Murray Abraham
reception.awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 6 wins & 33 nominations total.
